questions.question: What is the chemical symbol for water?
questions.explanation: Water = 2 Hydrogen atoms + 1 Oxygen atom. H2O is one of the most important molecules! 💧

questions.question: What force keeps us on the ground?
questions.explanation: Gravity is the force that pulls everything towards the centre of Earth! 🍎

questions.question: What is the hardest natural substance on Earth?
questions.explanation: Diamond is pure carbon arranged in a special way that makes it incredibly hard! 💎

questions.question: How many colours of light make up white light?
questions.explanation: White light contains all 7 rainbow colours — a prism splits them apart! 🌈

questions.question: What is the speed of light?
questions.explanation: Light travels at 299,792 km per second — so fast it circles Earth 7 times per second! ⚡

questions.question: What gas do plants breathe in to make food?
questions.explanation: Plants absorb CO2 and use sunlight to turn it into food — this is photosynthesis! 🌿

questions.question: What is the powerhouse of the cell?
questions.explanation: Mitochondria produce energy for the cell — that's why they're called the powerhouse! ⚡
